planets.name: TOI-707 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-707 with a 52.8-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-707 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-707. Its orbit and size follow Rea et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
